description_sq: Disponojme apartament per shitje me vendodhje ne Qender te Tiranes, Residenca Scanderbeg. Informacion mbi rezidencen: Ndertese multifunksionale e ndodhur ne zemer te kryeqytetit, e cila ofron apartamente elegante, zyra komode dhe ambiente komerciale moderne. Residenca Scanderbeg eshte nje objekt unik banimi dhe sherbimesh 9 dhe 13 kate mbi toke me 1 kat sherbimi nentoke dhe 3 kate parkimi nentoke. Ndodhet ne zonen me ideale per jetese dhe zhvillim biznesi. Scanderbeg Residence është vetëm pak minuta e madhe qendrore dhe me akses te pakrahasueshem me te gjitha qendrat e vendit te qendres ne kryeqytet. Informacion mbi apartamentin: • Siperfaqja bruto : 69.3 m2. • Siperfaqja neto : 57.9 m2. • Kati i 9. • Lartesia 3.50 m2. • Pamje e lire dhe panoramike. • Godine me standarte te larta projektimi dhe ndertimi. • Objekti perbehet nga 4 kate nentoke. • Fasade e ventiluar . • Veshje strukturale me shtrese termoizolimi dhe pllake qeramike HT (high teck) • Dritaret jane me vetrate termike me kase alumini. • Xham tripleks me mbushje me gaz argon qe mundeson izolim termik dhe akustik, grile me membrane akustike. • Ftohës sistemi. • Ambi te perbashketa te mireuara dhe te gjelberuara.. • Mundesi e mire investimi. Për ta vizituar na kontaktoni!
description_en: We have an apartment for sale located in the Center of Tirana, Scanderbeg Residence. Information about the residence: Multifunctional building located in the heart of the capital, which offers elegant apartments, comfortable offices and modern commercial premises. The Scanderbeg Residence is a unique residential and service facility 9 and 13 floors above ground with 1 underground service floor and 3 underground parking floors. It is located in the most ideal area for living and business development. Scanderbeg Residence is just a few minutes away from the center and with unparalleled access to all the country's centers of the capital city. Information about the apartment: • Gross area: 69.3 m2. • Net area: 57.9 m2. • 9th floor. • Height 3.50 m2. • Free and panoramic view. • Buildings with high design and construction standards. • The facility consists of 4 underground floors. • Ventilated facade. • Structural coating with thermal insulation layer and HT ceramic plates (high teck) • The windows are thermal glass with aluminum case. • Triplex glass filled with argon gas that enables thermal and acoustic insulation, shutters with acoustic membranes. • System cooler. • Improved and green common areas.. • Good investment opportunity. To visit it, contact us!
